title: Paxos media placeholder
description: A plain token-coloured surface standing in for a render, photo or film until a real one is passed in: the cool pale-grey frame of the product renders, a faint aqua-to-lime wash for hero art, a deeper aqua-to-lime field for editorial images, or a dark slate for film. It fills the box it is given.
notes: size, radius and shape come from the parent or className
